labels.label: context
labels.reason: The CSRF_COOKIE_MASKED setting is only deprecated, so it still works and needs no action in this release.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The name argument of cached_property is deprecated but still accepted, so existing code keeps working.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Moving ExclusionConstraint opclasses to OpClass() causes makemigrations to generate new RemoveConstraint/AddConstraint operations that the user must wrap in SeparateDatabaseAndState, which is migration work.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Passing errors=None to assertFormError is deprecated while errors=[] is the replacement, so tests keep working for now.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: PickleSerializer is deprecated for security reasons, so deployments using it may need to switch serializers and handle existing sessions.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: QuerySet.iterator() with prefetch_related now needs a chunk_size, and previously no prefetching happened, so existing code can see changed query behavior.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Passing unsaved model instances to related filters only emits a deprecation warning now and the exception comes in Django 5.0.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: RemoteUserBackend subclasses whose configure_user does not accept the new created argument are deprecated and will break, so they need updating.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The django.utils.timezone.utc alias is deprecated but still works, so only a warning is produced.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Passing a response object with a form name to assertFormError is deprecated but still functions, and the replacement pattern is given.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The undocumented OpenLayersWidget is deprecated, which only produces a warning.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: CryptPasswordHasher is deprecated but remains available, so no immediate action is needed.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Passing nulls_first=False or nulls_last=False is deprecated in favor of None, but the old form still works.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The default.html form templates are deprecated proxies that still work, and the specific templates are the recommended replacement.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: LogoutView.get_next_page() is renamed to get_success_url(), so overrides of the old method will no longer be called.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: This is a documentation pointer to the 3.2 deprecated-features notes and requires no direct action in itself.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for setUpTestData class attributes that cannot be deep-copied is removed, so affected tests will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Using a boolean value for BaseCommand.requires_system_checks is removed, so custom commands must be updated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The whitelist argument and domain_whitelist attribute of EmailValidator are removed, so code using them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The default_app_config variable is removed, so apps relying on it must be updated to use the new automatic app config discovery.
